root.statement: There exists one typed relational carrier C with geometric structure G, admissible dynamics D and observable maps O whose realizations recover a declared physical target set T, agree across shared regimes, satisfy predeclared empirical tests E and impose falsifiable explanatory constraints F.
root.quantifiers: One common source witness across the selected physical targets. Source conventions, imported physical laws, calibration inputs and held-out observations are separately recorded. Each recovery law names its regime, tolerance or exact identity, and verification level.
root.assembly: Scoped source/sector witnesses, overlap comparisons, empirical records and explanatory tests must compose on the same declared source. Root admission additionally requires a reviewed common-witness assembly record.
root.extension: All-physics ambition is pursued through versioned target-set extension and compatible overlaps. A bounded target-set result states its scope explicitly.

operator_stimulus: Invest in properly setting up the physics programme as the central research net.

status_semantics.resolved: A scoped cited result or accepted prerequisite is available; strength is recorded in evidence_mode.
status_semantics.open: Research or review task with a concrete deliverable.
status_semantics.deferred: A named external ingredient is missing; blocker and reopening_condition are mandatory and the node is excluded from actionable frontier.
status_semantics.outcome: Only the previously accepted finite-overlap node imports ++. Other formal outcomes remain null.
status_semantics.owner: Suggested research/review lead, not a task claim or exclusive mutation authority.

port_contract.knowledge: Scoped research knowledge; may include constructed results or rejections.
port_contract.witness: Constructed scoped witness; requires verdict constructed and compatible evidence scope.
port_contract.counterexample: Scoped rejection witness; requires verdict rejected.
port_contract.input_requirements: Each dependency is wired to exactly one of these output ports. Wiring organizes research; a witness input still needs the consumer's explicit transport/acceptance test.
port_contract.interfaces: External reviewed records supplement local prerequisites; missing records keep a task off the executable frontier.

available_interfaces.review: Nima bounded target charter: exact independent model controls, explicit imported inputs, missing common-source maps and frozen empirical decision requirements

interface_definitions.acceptance: Select at least one physical target ID from the catalog, with regime, law/output to recover, assumptions and success/failure rules. Record the review and frozen target-set digest.
Named instrument/preparation, traceable calibration, complete records, uncertainty and provenance; fitting and validation observations plus preprocessing dependencies separated.
Explicit assembly argument over the same source witness and selected targets, addressing all five principal obligations, admitted evidence strengths and residuals.

overlap_records.common_domain: Vacuum plus one photon in ten retained modes, tensor classical R/D memory
overlap_records.comparison: Per-passive-leg and per-labelled-Kraus inclusion squares; ordered complete posterior/record comparison through three rounds

conjectures.statement: The accepted Bool spectral complex/real structural overlap preserves the same witness, retained schedules and quadratic readouts.
conjectures.scope: Existing native Bool spectral overlap export only; parameter theta=pi*t and z*Hz=2E_H conventions retained.
conjectures.acceptance: Resolve the existing accepted pointer and pass its live external-dependency admission check.
conjectures.falsifier: Revoked export, source drift or mismatched scope blocks reuse.

conjectures.statement: Selected retained T9 promotion preserves/reflects the original 977 comparison pairs and retains records, masses and J4.
conjectures.scope: The exact-domain 137->32->32 software policy and its fixed source instance.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse source labels, endpoint policy, record reconstruction and two diagram squares unchanged.
conjectures.falsifier: A candidate common-source embedding changes the selected comparison domain or record identity.

conjectures.statement: The declared interface-preserving law transports through complete retained T9 and has a 38-coordinate energy observer with 99 retained kernel directions per channel.
conjectures.scope: Declared coefficient law and normalization; the energy task uses (a,b) under common gain.
conjectures.acceptance: Keep full source reconstruction and law-selection premises explicit.
conjectures.falsifier: Family means alone are used as the energy state or the changed law is identified with the old rotor.

conjectures.statement: Bool and retained exchange sources have faithful separate adapters and a tagged C4 plus C22 package.
conjectures.scope: Source-indexed alternatives with typed operations and retained records; fixed-port overlap attempts retain their rank obstructions.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse each source's carrier, metric, seams and operation domain separately.
conjectures.falsifier: Disjoint block placement is treated as a shared physical source or authorizes mixed-source words.

conjectures.statement: The tested full native-pair and encounter-cycle identifications with the coefficient dynamics fail operation transport.
conjectures.scope: Fourteen native pair energies versus five target eigenvalues for the stated injective intertwiner; encounter fifth-order cycle versus selection-preserving involutive relabellings.
conjectures.acceptance: A successor must name the changed domain/map/operation and retain the old counterexamples.
conjectures.falsifier: The original spectral/cycle residuals persist under the proposed unchanged identification.
conjectures.counterexample: Metric embedding exists for the selected encounter sector while its tested native cycle has no compatible target operation.

conjectures.statement: Existing cavity and finite-memory detector models supply explicit preparation, ordered port, loss/memory and observation structures.
conjectures.scope: Given optical/instrument laws and parameter conventions; model records distinguished from acquired observations.
conjectures.acceptance: Retain environment ports, delay and detector memory; preserve the hidden-state/predictive-belief distinction.
conjectures.falsifier: Loss compression is treated as a closed unitary device or one-time effects replace the history-dependent instrument.

conjectures.evidence_mode: reviewed bounded target specification with independent rational instrument controls; no physical or empirical admission
conjectures.statement: Freeze a bounded primary physical target set and its recovery contracts.
conjectures.scope: Catalog v3 selects ordered reciprocal lossy-cavity response and finite ready/dead detector records through three steps. Imported laws, independent calibration, common-source comparison and empirical protocol gates remain explicit.
conjectures.acceptance: Each selected target names a regime, physical source model, observation law, source derivation task, allowed imported inputs, exact/tolerance criterion and independent test route.
conjectures.falsifier: A target is selected by name without its source-to-observation comparison or its law is inserted as the conclusion to be explained.
conjectures.next_action: Construct the same-source geometry, dynamics and instrument bindings for the frozen pair; freeze the acquisition protocol before any validation records.
conjectures.deliverable: Reviewed physical-target scope and target-set digest; populated selected_physical_targets with physical/empirical witnesses still open.

conjectures.evidence_mode: source-indexed provenance register; independent exact Bool record/action adapter and written finite-word induction; other source maps at their cited review strength
conjectures.statement: Construct the current common-source candidate register and typed maps from actual source instances.
conjectures.scope: Eleven base sources and the versioned passive-port-fock-memory.v1 supplement. The base register retains its maps and obstructions; the supplement supplies conditional optical/instrument geometry without identifying native sources or establishing physical realization.
conjectures.acceptance: Record source ID, operations, event/history identity, geometry/dynamics/observer ingredients and classification as native, derived, convention, imported law, calibration or test data.
conjectures.falsifier: Shared schema, dimension, energy or notation is used as the common-witness map.
conjectures.next_action: Bind the charter's target requirements to the registered source IDs and ingredient roles; construct each missing common-source comparison at its stated operation/record scope.
conjectures.deliverable: Versioned witness register with source maps, allowed uses and missing comparison ports.

conjectures.evidence_mode: reviewed scoped contribution-port table; live receipt hashes and independent exact controls
conjectures.statement: Review Sontag's fixed-WG/energy control realization and formal retained-history transport for use by the central programme.
conjectures.scope: Four accepted ports: fixed-Composite history, exact energy feedback, external authority/resource context and conditional optical statistical feedback. Marked attachment transport and empirical optical realization remain named residuals.
conjectures.acceptance: Check precise source types, proposal scopes and receipt freshness; publish accepted contribution ports or unresolved typed comparisons.
conjectures.falsifier: A fixed Composite F,G result is promoted to every WG equivalence or relation-algebra attachment.
conjectures.next_action: Use the accepted contribution-port table in the central source register and target charter, preserving event versions, preparation/calibration provenance and the phase-sensitive extension control.
conjectures.deliverable: Scoped review disposition and contribution bindings; original child net remains under its own review process.

conjectures.evidence_mode: reviewed conditional Fock/memory geometry with written completion argument and independent exact operation squares
conjectures.statement: Realize the selected common-source candidate geometrically at the target's required stratum.
conjectures.scope: Fock/memory optical candidate with declared Hilbert/field geometry, coherent cavity and finite-detector maps, retained histories and completion argument. Physical clock and native relational comparison remain additional bindings.
conjectures.acceptance: Give source-to-geometry maps preserving relevant operations and identities; state finite/completed domain and exact recovery law.
conjectures.falsifier: Equal invariants replace the missing geometric map or a coordinate parameter silently becomes physical time.
conjectures.next_action: Use the reviewed geometric maps in source-law selection and the common-source instrument assembly; carry the coherent/finite-photon domain distinction into every overlap.
conjectures.deliverable: Typed geometric binding and completion/causal obligations.

conjectures.statement: Derive or independently justify the selected source operation law and its dynamics/parameter interpretation.
conjectures.scope: Compare source-admissible alternatives using fixed target criteria and retained records.
conjectures.acceptance: Specify operation family, constraints, interpolation if used, clock/rate and energy conventions with provenance and discriminating predictions.
conjectures.falsifier: A law is selected only because it fits the desired readout, or its native operation cannot be transported.
conjectures.next_action: Supply a native principle excluding higher-degree interactions and a continuous primitive operation/generator selecting its logarithm branch, component durations and units. The new quadratic-generator theorem is conditional; two positive local generators with identical sampled mirror maps exhibit the remaining branch obstruction. Measurement execution stays parked.
conjectures.blocker: Reviewed source packets supply optical/CP laws and coefficients, not a native quadraticity principle, selected continuous primitive generator/logarithm branch or physical clock/energy provenance. Conditional sufficiency and exact nonuniqueness are recorded; repeating supplied-law checks cannot fill these source inputs.
conjectures.reopening_condition: A versioned native source contribution supplies the missing operation principle, generator/branch and units with independent provenance, for comparison against the retained Kerr and clock-branch countermodels.
conjectures.deliverable: Source-law selection witness or candidate-specific obstruction.

conjectures.evidence_mode: reviewed source-model instrument, record, filter and resource contract with named physical slots
conjectures.statement: Specify authorized preparations, controls, observations and resource accounts for the selected target interfaces.
conjectures.scope: Distinguish physical state, retained record, predictive state and observable quotient.
conjectures.acceptance: Declare instrument/effect maps, complete record spaces, history updates, loss/back-action, units and calibration authority.
conjectures.falsifier: An observer or matrix span is treated as an executable intervention, or hidden memory is reset without an operation.
conjectures.next_action: Use the accepted interface to freeze the field-mean and complete-count measurement protocols, filling the named preparation/calibration/clock/resource slots with the instrument owner.
conjectures.deliverable: Typed preparation/control/instrument contract with unresolved physical-source slots.

conjectures.evidence_mode: Reviewed conditional model assembly at imported-law scope; coherent cavity and full sharp-input detector maps use the same carrier with distinct domains, complex overlap and guarded compositions. No physical/native-source admission.
conjectures.statement: Assemble the supplied-law optical and classical detector model maps on the registered Fock/memory candidate.
conjectures.scope: Three-round coherent cavity and sharp-input detector model presentations; reviewed single-excitation overlap; N=2 safe domain retained as a separate schedule-specific candidate.
conjectures.acceptance: Verify per-target conditional coverage, common carrier ID, complete histories, domain guards and provenance; preserve all independent source and physical authority gaps.
conjectures.falsifier: A common carrier ID silently identifies incompatible preparations, discards multiphoton mass, or promotes imported-law reuse into physical explanation.
conjectures.next_action: Reuse this conditional construction as scoped knowledge while awaiting the missing native-source and physical binding contributions.
conjectures.deliverable: Scoped conditional target-coverage and assembly review.

conjectures.statement: The candidate carrier supports the selected geometry and admissible dynamics with compatible source provenance.
conjectures.scope: Selected source and physical target regime.
conjectures.acceptance: Compose the three typed bindings and check identity/composition/constraint diagrams on the same witness.
conjectures.falsifier: Geometry and dynamics bind different source objects or incompatible operation domains.
conjectures.next_action: Review the incoming source/geometry/dynamics comparison cells together.
conjectures.deliverable: Scoped carrier-and-dynamics assembly.

conjectures.evidence_mode: Scoped same-source register binding; written all-word/projector/block transport, exact retained-record controls and live accepted mixed-level overlap import; no new kernel or physical claim
conjectures.statement: Bind the accepted finite structural pilot to the current common-source candidate interface.
conjectures.scope: Existing accepted verification level and source laws retained exactly.
conjectures.acceptance: Specify embedding/interpretation and operation/record maps; check scale, readout and schedule transport.
conjectures.falsifier: The accepted Bool result is relabelled as the universal carrier or physical target recovery.
conjectures.next_action: Reuse the reviewed Bool-to-register binding at its finite structural scope; any Bool-to-optical or other cross-source comparison requires a separate map and may not identify source IDs.
conjectures.deliverable: Programme binding for the accepted prerequisite.

conjectures.statement: Select the exact scattering model contributions and missing numerical/physical maps for a future target extension.
conjectures.scope: Preserve the child net's numerical energy/response/continuum gates and source calibration/species distinctions.
conjectures.acceptance: Map each selected target requirement to a versioned child claim or a missing witness; keep source-model computations and physical binding as separate ports.
conjectures.falsifier: Saved kernel replay closes continuum or physical-law selection, or conditional contact/switching rules are presented as derived.
conjectures.blocker: High-energy scattering is outside the frozen primary pair and retains numerical, source-law and physical-map gates.
conjectures.reopening_condition: A versioned target extension selects a bounded scattering prediction with controlled numerical errors and independent scale/source-selection information.
conjectures.next_action: Preserve native operation/scale counterexamples and review a supplied bounded expansion packet; child-net research continues independently.
conjectures.deliverable: Scattering requirement/contribution table for a reviewed target expansion.

conjectures.statement: Bind the retained coefficient Hamiltonian and energy reader to physical preparation, actuation, clock, energy and records.
conjectures.scope: A selected physical realization of that model.
conjectures.acceptance: Provide source-authorized physical maps and calibration/resource accounting before importing model energy as measured energy.
conjectures.falsifier: Changing a coefficient or reading a model field is used as physical actuator/detector evidence.
conjectures.blocker: No physical preparation/actuation/readout/clock binding for the retained coefficient model is supplied by the cited packets.
conjectures.reopening_condition: A named source packet supplies these maps and a bounded validation protocol.
conjectures.next_action: Review the supplied physical-binding packet when available.
conjectures.deliverable: Physical realization witness or explicit failed candidate.

conjectures.statement: Connect a selected source-typed instrument model to the same carrier's state and operations.
conjectures.scope: Candidate cavity/detector or reviewed Compton interface, under its declared imported laws and regime.
conjectures.acceptance: Give source-to-plant and source-to-record maps commuting with composition, memory/loss and observations; label each imported law versus derived constraint.
conjectures.falsifier: A faithful encoding reproduces an imported answer while the claimed source derivation remains absent.
conjectures.next_action: Review the conditional full sharp-input detector history embedding and routed single-excitation cavity overlap after carrier/source-law prerequisites are supplied. Preserve the explicit passive-mixing multiphoton guard; physical preparations and clock/authority maps remain unfilled.
conjectures.deliverable: Instrument realization binding and law-provenance comparison.

conjectures.statement: Every selected physical target has a realization from the same carrier witness satisfying its recovery contract.
conjectures.scope: Exactly selected_physical_targets; per-target realization records are required in addition to the local prerequisites.
conjectures.acceptance: For each selected target, bind source, law, regime, observation and recovery witness; distinguish conditional model realization from source-derived physical explanation.
conjectures.falsifier: A selected target lacks its required map or uses an incompatible source witness.
conjectures.next_action: Review per-target witness records against the frozen target catalog and incoming bindings.
conjectures.deliverable: Complete selected-target realization manifest.

conjectures.evidence_mode: Reviewed single-excitation overlap specification; written complex-linear passive/Kraus inclusion proof and independent exact density/Fock posterior controls; no physical sector admission
conjectures.statement: Define the actual shared regimes and comparison cells between selected target realizations.
conjectures.scope: State/action/observable/resource and history attachment overlap, with exact or controlled approximation conventions.
conjectures.acceptance: List each overlap's common domain, two routes, required comparison and falsifier; preserve known fixed-fibre failures as scoped controls.
conjectures.falsifier: Shared names, dimensions or scalar outputs substitute for an overlap domain and transport map.
conjectures.next_action: Reuse the reviewed overlap domain, two ordered routes and excluded-domain controls in common-source instrument binding and sector transport; supply source-law and physical-clock/preparation bindings separately.
conjectures.deliverable: Versioned overlap catalog with explicit comparison ports.

conjectures.statement: The selected sector realizations agree on the declared overlaps while preserving the common source witness.
conjectures.scope: All overlaps in the reviewed catalog, including compositions of comparisons.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct state/action/readout transport and coherence on triple overlaps where present; retain all residuals.
conjectures.falsifier: Pairwise endpoint agreement fails operation transport or composed comparison coherence.
conjectures.next_action: Reuse the reviewed single-excitation overlap and conditional history maps; the new maximal three-round N=2 safe domain has dimension 52 with three independent constraints. Preserve later-bin failure witnesses and do not treat this schedule-specific candidate as physical transport or arbitrary-operation invariance.
conjectures.deliverable: Overlap witness family and coherence coverage record.

conjectures.statement: Sector transports and shared observables agree at the declared stratum across the selected physical targets.
conjectures.scope: Reviewed physical overlap catalog; finite structural overlap remains a scoped prerequisite.
conjectures.acceptance: Review the complete common-witness comparison family with its regimes and evidence levels.
conjectures.falsifier: An omitted overlap or incompatible normalization changes a shared prediction.
conjectures.next_action: Assemble reviewed overlap witnesses at their stated scope.
conjectures.deliverable: Scoped cross-sector compatibility result.

conjectures.statement: Freeze complete empirical protocols for the selected physical targets.
conjectures.scope: Preparation, instrument records including rejection/no-click, calibration, nuisance model, preprocessing, uncertainty, sample/stopping rule and held-out evaluation.
conjectures.acceptance: Separate fitting/calibration and validation data and dependencies; specify the prediction and decision rule before observing the validation records.
conjectures.falsifier: Selection or preprocessing leaks validation information into fitted predictions, or discarded records change the test.
conjectures.next_action: Review the fixed-sample coherent-field protocol candidate, justify its readout/noise/calibration and reset assumptions, and supply the separate complete-count detector protocol. No physical authorization or acquired data is supplied.
conjectures.deliverable: Frozen protocol and data provenance schema.

conjectures.statement: Acquire or identify independently sourced calibrated records satisfying the frozen protocol.
conjectures.scope: Actual observations and instrument provenance for selected targets.
conjectures.acceptance: Validate record completeness, calibration traceability, timestamps/ordering where applicable and frozen split/stopping rules.
conjectures.falsifier: Model-generated records are used as observed data or calibration provenance fails.
conjectures.blocker: No acquired independent data bundle for the proposed programme target set is supplied.
conjectures.reopening_condition: An instrument/data owner supplies a traceable dataset matching a frozen protocol.
conjectures.next_action: Validate the incoming data bundle against the frozen protocol.
conjectures.deliverable: Calibrated independent-record manifest.

conjectures.statement: The selected realization predictions pass their predeclared independent empirical comparisons.
conjectures.scope: Frozen dataset split, nuisance policy, uncertainty and decision rules.
conjectures.acceptance: Execute the frozen test, report residuals and uncertainty, and compare preregistered rivals.
conjectures.falsifier: Held-out records exclude the prediction under the audited protocol.
conjectures.next_action: Run the frozen comparison once the validated dataset and prediction manifest exist.
conjectures.deliverable: Empirical test receipt including failures and rival comparisons.

conjectures.statement: Selected targets meet their declared empirical tests with explicit calibration and uncertainty accounting.
conjectures.scope: Exactly the tested protocols and target regimes.
conjectures.acceptance: Check coverage across every selected target's required empirical tests, including negative records and uncertainty.
conjectures.falsifier: A required empirical test is absent or contradicted.
conjectures.next_action: Review empirical coverage and source-to-record bindings.
conjectures.deliverable: Scoped empirical recovery manifest.

conjectures.evidence_mode: Scoped frozen nine-rival table with fresh exact model controls, nominal separation margins and explicit classical/low-sector/provenance aliases; no empirical exclusions
conjectures.statement: Freeze explanatory rivals and consequences that distinguish the proposed common-source account.
conjectures.scope: Compare imported-law reproductions, alternative source laws, hidden-state quotients and the proposed source-derived account.
conjectures.acceptance: Name each rival, its common observations and a discriminating source operation or held-out prediction, with fixed parameter policy.
conjectures.falsifier: Every possible observation is accommodated by a new per-target adapter or parameter fit.
conjectures.next_action: Reuse the frozen rival controls and explicit alias regions in source-law and structural robustness work; do not promote supplied-law prediction reuse to native-source derivation.
conjectures.deliverable: Preregistered rival/prediction table and source-dependence audit.

conjectures.evidence_mode: Written continuum-of-CP-completions and all-adaptive-classical-policy induction; fresh exact finite controls and sharp minimax inverse obstruction
conjectures.statement: The frozen classical record vocabulary uniquely identifies the full detector quantum completion.
conjectures.scope: Sharp zero/one photon preparations, classical memory and parameter-independent adaptive classical policies; not the classical eta/gamma/r reference-family inverse or physical existence of some realization.
conjectures.acceptance: Compare all admissible classical histories and full CP channel action; preserve quantum-completion scope.
conjectures.falsifier: A continuum of distinct normalized CP instruments has the same classical maps and all adaptive record laws.
conjectures.counterexample: Phi_lambda=(1-lambda)Phi_separated+lambda Phi_merged has constant classical laws but coherent-memory X=4lambda/5; any record-only estimator has worst-case squared-error risk at least 1/4.

conjectures.statement: The chosen discriminators separate the intended source candidates under the admitted nuisance and noise class.
conjectures.scope: Structural identifiability, scale aliases, hidden memory and stability margins are separately tested.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct exact alias/hidden-state controls and quantitative bounds or explicit failure regions; preserve source parameter constraints.
conjectures.falsifier: Distinct source candidates remain observationally identical under all proposed measurements, or the inverse is unstable in the claimed regime.
conjectures.next_action: Restrict identifiability claims to the classical operational equivalence class, or supply an independent source premise selecting the quantum completion. Full CP identification from this vocabulary is now rejected by a continuum/all-adaptive-policy theorem with sharp minimax risk 1/4. The classical eta/gamma/r inverse remains valid; measurement work stays parked.
conjectures.deliverable: Identifiability/robustness witness or precise required extra measurement.

conjectures.statement: The account imposes tested constraints beyond inserted laws or fitted answers.
conjectures.scope: Frozen target/rival set and tested discriminator regimes.
conjectures.acceptance: Show which alternatives are excluded or predictions independently confirmed and which source ingredients generate those consequences.
conjectures.falsifier: The apparent success is entirely supplied by imported target laws or unidentifiable fitting freedoms.
conjectures.next_action: Review the source-dependence and rival-test records together.
conjectures.deliverable: Scoped explanatory-constraint result.

conjectures.statement: The physics programme root holds over its explicitly reviewed physical target scope.
conjectures.scope: One common witness, all selected target recovery laws, overlap conditions and independent tests.
conjectures.acceptance: Review the assembly argument and every source/target/interface binding, preserving the exact evidence strengths and tested regimes.
conjectures.falsifier: Any required binding or test fails at the claimed common-witness scope.
conjectures.next_action: Assemble only after all five principal obligations and the root review interface are supplied.
conjectures.deliverable: Explicit scoped root admission or documented surviving candidate frontier.

Exact event/history/operation map for the selected source; retain relation attachments and schedule conventions.
Scoped state/action/record and resource bindings; physical authority and calibration separately sourced.
Canonical-form comparison at its fixed n=8 source scope; a geometric target binding is a further map.
Domain/operation/form comparison on the selected common source; arithmetic examples are auxiliary until that binding exists.
Separate numerical completion, contact/switching source law, physical calibration and species/readout maps.

execution_policy.basis: Operator instruction: complete remaining non-measurement work rather than repeatedly returning to measurements.
execution_policy.interpretation: Scheduling policy only: open/deferred dispositions and scientific dependency gates are unchanged. Identifiability work focuses on structural aliases and mathematical robustness, not measurement planning. Root and explanatory assembly still require their eventual empirical inputs.
execution_policy.resume_condition: Non-measurement construction, proof and review obligations are completed or explicit source obstructions are recorded; operator may also explicitly reopen measurement work.
